requirements.description: Monthly stock returns, month-end prices, monthly high/low, volume, and shares outstanding for all CRSP stocks 1962-2001 (monthly returns R_{i,t}, 52-week-high ratio from month-end prices, market cap = |prc| x shrout x 1000, GH turnover V_t = vol / (shrout x 1000))
Daily closing prices for computing the 12-month maximum price (52-week high) as max of daily closes; used as alternative to the msf monthly high (askhi) for robustness of the 52-week-high signal
Point-in-time share codes (shrcd 10/11 common-stock filter), exchange codes, and 2-digit SIC codes (hsiccd/siccd) for the MG 20-industry classification, valid over namedt..nameendt windows
Delisting dates, codes and delisting returns for robustness checks on loser-portfolio returns (paper is silent on delisting treatment; default is msf ret without dlret)

Fama-French (1996) monthly factors Mkt-RF, SMB, HML (plus RF) for the risk-adjustment time-series regressions of Tables V and VII; ff.four_factor_monthly is monthly (month-end dt), in decimals, and covers 1963-07 to 2001-12 with exactly the paper's 462 months (ff.three_factor is daily — not used).
